title: Book of Revelation: people who cannot die

tellings.quote: befalling on earth you have a group of people who cannot die

plain: The Book of Revelation, the last book of the Christian Bible, is said to describe a time of disaster on earth when a group of people cannot die. Tim Alberino, a researcher who says giants were captured in Afghanistan, raises it himself from his reading of the text. He uses it to link ancient prophecy to the strange beings he talks about.
